title: Brown's work continues in black aerospace subcompartments

tellings.quote: But in deep black American aerospace, I believe Brown's work still exists in the form of whispers and vital subcompartments where it gets explored further.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he believes that the work of a researcher named Thomas Townsend Brown, who tried to use electricity to affect gravity, still lives on inside the most secret parts of the American aerospace industry. In his words, it survives as whispers in tightly walled-off sub-projects where it keeps being explored. If true, it would mean the research never died but simply went out of public view.
